content.text:
Added these entries to `.gitignore`, and `git status` now shows only the `.gitignore` change:

- `.agents/skills/`
- `.beads/identity.toml`
- `.env.local`
- `.opencode/skills/`

I haven't committed the change. Your last commit ("ignore Gas City beads directory except identity file") deliberately kept `.beads/identity.toml` visible. Ignoring it overrides that, so remove that line if you want it tracked.
not .agent/skills just the GC ones! so /core + individual gas city skils

I replaced the blanket `.agents/skills/` entry with ones that only match the Gas City skills:

- `.agents/skills/.gc-skill-ownership.json`
- `.agents/skills/core.gc-*`, which covers the `core.gc-agents`, `-city`, `-dashboard`, `-dispatch`, `-mail`, `-rigs` and `-work` skills.
- `.agents/skills/gascity.*`, which covers `gascity.mayor`.

Any other skill you add under `.agents/skills/` will now show up in `git status` as normal. `git status` shows only the `.gitignore` change, so all the Gas City files are ignored.

I left `.opencode/skills/` ignored as a whole directory. If it also holds non-Gas City skills, tell me and I'll narrow it the same way.
